Hey friends, it's time for the 2026 life update. In this one I'm talking about being a dad to a toddler and the question I keep asking other parents, what life in Hong Kong looks like two years in, and why I started a boys group. Then we go to the new office (still a building site) to talk about work: why I'm building a business school, how the business fits together, and how it all started. Hope you enjoy xx
